pages.title: Electricity Always Exists
pages.text: The Xianeng Electricity Crystal registers, stores FE, and charges items even with no other power mod. Default capacity is 800,000,000 FE and base burn output is 1,000 FE/t. A plugin multiplies production without changing fuel burn time.

pages.title: Shared Slots and Output
pages.text: All three crystals share one layout: processing enters from above, fuel from the sides, and the extra slot extracts only from below. With a plugin in that slot, a full container stays in processing and Certus-style charging recipes are rejected. The extra slot never enters Xianqiao, regardless of the output switch.

pages.title: Local Cache or Xianqiao Ledger
pages.text: A crystal first binds to the owner of its current Xianqiao, then falls back to a Spirit Drive. Xianqiao Output can turn on only when bound: it flushes local cache, then points the capability and meter at the owner's ledger. Turning it off detaches and re-enables an empty local cache. Face output is independent.

pages.title: Xianeng Mana Crystal
pages.text: With Botania installed, the green Mana variant produces a base 1,000 Mana/t and actively talks only to official containers such as ManaReceiver. Its processing slot charges ManaItem containers including Mana Tablets and Rings.

pages.title: Spark and Mana Ledger
pages.text: A Spark can attach to the Mana Crystal; connection state reloads from block data without dropping or duplicating it. With Xianqiao Output on, capability, meter, and external networks share the owner's long-valued Mana ledger. Turning it off restores local cache.

pages.title: Xianeng Source Crystal
pages.text: With Ars Nouveau installed, the purple Source variant produces a base 1,000 Source/t and actively talks only to ISourceCap containers. Its processing slot charges Source Jars and other registered Source containers.

pages.title: Dominion Wand and Source Ledger
pages.text: A Dominion Wand may mark the Source Crystal as a network start or priority point; both marks persist in block data across reloads. With Xianqiao Output on, capability, meter, and external networks share the owner's long-valued Source ledger.

pages.title: Crystal-Family Conversion
pages.text: Available variants form one Xianeng Crystal family. Stonecutting converts between any variants that exist, while one shapeless item converts to the next existing variant in order. Without Botania or Ars Nouveau, its block, item, capability, and recipes do not load.

pages.title: Resource Boundary
pages.text: FE, Mana, and Source are independent long-valued ledgers and never invoke the removed non-source Immortal Yuan conversion. Immortal Yuan or True Yuan serves only as crystal fuel. Existing Source Vein charging and exchange remain unchanged.
